configurations.name: uniliv-api
runtimeArgs: set -a; . ./.env.api; set +a; exec pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev

configurations.name: uniliv-web
runtimeArgs: _P="$PORT"; set -a; . ./.env.web; set +a; export PORT="${_P:-$PORT}"; exec pnpm --filter @workspace/uniliv-admin run dev

configurations.name: uniliv-api-8091
runtimeArgs: set -a; . ./.env.api; set +a; export PORT=8091 RUN_SCHEDULERS=false; exec pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run dev

configurations.name: uniliv-web-8091
runtimeArgs: _P="$PORT"; set -a; . ./.env.web; set +a; export PORT="${_P:-$PORT}" API_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:8091; exec pnpm --filter @workspace/uniliv-admin run dev

configurations.name: uniliv-web-audit
runtimeArgs: _P="$PORT"; set -a; . ./.env.web; set +a; export PORT="${_P:-$PORT}" API_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:8095; exec pnpm --filter @workspace/uniliv-admin run dev
